anomaly_resolutions.method: Internal cross-check against the SAME document's own Quantitative Requirements table (not merely a re-read of the ingredient table). MIL-DTL-24441/19B(SH) states Component B 'Pigment content, percent (%)' must fall in [81.5, 85.5]. Zinc pigment is Component B's only pigment ingredient (thixatrope amount is '---' for this formula).
anomaly_resolutions.result: Printed-kg-column pigment content = 34.0% -- FAILS the document's own 81.5-85.5% spec by a wide margin. Lb-column (equivalently, kg corrected via lb*0.453592 = 861.8 kg) pigment content = 83.6% -- PASSES the spec cleanly, near the range midpoint. This is a self-consistency proof internal to the primary source: only the 861.8 kg reading is compatible with the same document's own quantitative requirements table. CONCLUSION: the printed '86.84 kg' zinc-pigment figure is the transcription error; 861.8 kg (equivalently, use the 1900.0 lb figure) is correct. v1's flag is RESOLVED -- disposition upgraded from RECOMMENDED_WITH_FLAG to RECOMMENDED_WITH_RESOLVED_FLAG. The row is now usable as a known-answer control input provided the corrected 861.8 kg (not the printed 86.84 kg) is used.
anomaly_resolutions.still_not_done: This resolution proves WHICH figure is correct; it does not itself add a control to the locked fixture. That remains an R- item action per v1 followup 1, now unblocked for this specific row.
